title: Repeated elements are removed and the small layout and accessibility gaps are fixed
acceptance: "Jump back in" no longer repeats the Recents rows beside it.
Music rows drop the "Playlist ·"/"Song ·" prefixes, and the playlist dialog has one exit.
Account shows identity once, Sign out sits outside the profile form, Security has a heading, and each section has an accessible name.
The show-password toggle is at least 44px; the landing nav has a fallback below lg; the Classes tab sets its own document title; the "Steven" nav label is clearly an identity marker.
Every Classes control's accessible name includes its visible text (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name; absorbed from RF-73), checked at desktop and phone widths with the keyboard.
Browser checks done and recorded: Apple sign-in button logo, panel heading order, 10px badges, "SoundC..." and class-length truncation at 713 and 375px, Live sort label.
Optional, owner call: Exit from preflight returns focus to the card that opened it instead of the landmark H1 (#250).
